name: Agnes Reed
title: The Tavern Keeper
nickname: The Tavern Keeper; "the ears of the town"

origin.socialStatus: A commoner, but with influence among the people
origin.profession: A tavern keeper's daughter; now runs her father's tavern, the Drowned Anchor

appearance.face: A round, pretty face, freckles, a thin scar on the right eyebrow
appearance.hairAndEyes: Reddish hair in a braid, lively green eyes
appearance.clothing: A simple dress, a leather belt of keys, a cloth on her shoulder
appearance.gestures: Wipes the table even when it is clean; counts on her fingers
appearance.voice: A ringing, joking voice with a dockside accent
appearance.firstImpression: A cheerful, welcoming woman who seems to listen more than she talks
appearance.artistNotes: Keeps a small notebook in her apron where she writes down debts and rumours.

backstory.biography: Agnes grew up among drunks, sailors, merchants and soldiers in her father's tavern. She learned that a drunk man says more than a sober one would admit under torture. When her father died she took over the tavern along with his debts to the local moneylender. Today she knows half the town by name and the other half by rumour.
backstory.whyHere: The moneylender wants her tavern for the debt. She came to win the money — and to hear something useful.
backstory.secret: How big her debt is and how close she is to losing the tavern. Also, that she sometimes sells what she hears to whoever pays best.

psychology.weakness: Loves knowing more than others and sometimes says too much
psychology.fear: Losing the tavern, the only thing she has
psychology.desire: To keep the tavern and her independence
psychology.angers: Haughty people who don't pay their bill
psychology.regret: That she sometimes sells secrets about people who didn't deserve it
psychology.moralLimits: Never gives away friends' secrets. Strangers' secrets are merchandise

behavior.stakes: Moderate. Likes to see what the others do
behavior.deception: Cheats with information, rarely with cards
behavior.debts: Has a debt and it worries her
behavior.whenAttacks: When she knows an opponent's weakness
behavior.whenRetreats: When she sees someone is better informed

motives.hiddenGoal: To pay off her debt and keep the tavern
motives.betrayalTrigger: If someone offers to pay off her debt
motives.helpTrigger: If someone she likes is in trouble

speech.angerAndFear: Turns cold and serious, her voice drops

mechanics.strangeness: She can hear a conversation from the far end of any hall. Sometimes even the host's whispers.
mechanics.temptation: Loves knowing more than others and sometimes says too much
mechanics.ability: Eavesdrop: once per evening she learns what the host whispered to another player.
mechanics.hostRelation: Fear — she knows the rumours about this table better than anyone.

authorNotes.distinctive: The information hub of the table. Can be a key ally or a dangerous enemy.
authorNotes.immutable: The observation, the tavern, the debt.
authorNotes.tunable: How fast she reads opponents and how often she lets things slip.

lines.text: Welcome! Sit, sit. Everyone's a friend here — until they pay the bill.
Ha! Drinks are on me tonight!
Well, a tavern has its bad nights. Tomorrow will be better.
Me? Darling, I only pour and listen.
An alliance? Go on — but first tell me something I don't know.
Ah, so that's how it is. Fine. I'll remember.
Hm, risky. But my father used to say: who never risks, never drinks.
Agnes Reed of the Drowned Anchor. Whatever you say in front of her, all of Saltmarsh knows by morning.
Oh, you again! Sit down — your tab is still open.

tells.description: Counts on her fingers under the table
Wipes the table even when it is clean

relations.story: Godfrey Mott is the moneylender who wants to take her tavern for her father's debt.
relations.effect: Agnes turns her attacks on Godfrey at the first chance.
